in_marathi.name: Juman
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of the river Jumana
in_marathi.long_meaning: Juman हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। In Hindu mythology, Juman is the name of a goddess associated with the Jumana river. She is often depicted as a goddess of fertility and abundance, protecting and nurturing all life along the riverbanks.
